source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: The code is reused at Functionality row 1461 for Flash by BMC WebUI; the DeepSeek flash content was contaminated by that different row. This record is locked to row 362.

source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power-off SUT, and check POST code on the 7 segment display.
2. Power-on SUT, and check POST code on the 7 segment display.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. When SUT is off, POST code should show "06".
2. When SUT is on, POST code should show "02:".

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Flash by BMC WebUI: flash the BIOS from the BMC webUI (Operations -> Firmware Update -> browse BIOS .cap -> Flash). Web-UI flash is operator/agent-UI + state-changing; agent drives the Redfish UpdateService equivalent and verifies the new BIOS version sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory" 2>&1 | grep -iA1 bios 2>&1" after the user designates the image.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the Redfish flash task result + the pre/post BIOS version so the user confirms the BIOS flashed via BMC WebUI to the expected version.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: BIOS flash is state-changing and can brick the machine if interrupted; use the user-designated image and never power-cut mid-flash.
deepseek_columns.remark: same code in 2 workbook rows (multi-row code)

historical_reviews.deepseek: Mismatched to the later same-code BMC flash row; its image, UpdateService and inventory steps are inapplicable.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / CHANGED; restores seven-segment observation, controlled power states and recovery evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: Exact-code history confirms the multi-row collision.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical seven-segment POST display reads 06 in the source-defined SUT-off state and 02: in the source-defined SUT-on observation state.
original_method: Identify the board display, establish and record the exact off state, visually capture 06, execute the approved power-on sequence, capture the specified on-state point and 02: representation, then verify normal boot and logs.
manual_activity: A human must observe and capture the physical seven-segment display in both precisely identified power states; BMC or OS data cannot establish the visible segments.
required_inputs: Meaning of SUT off and on observation timing
Confirmation whether 02: includes a literal colon/indicator
Approved power method/window and workload drain
safety_requirements: Obtain one authorized approval for the unchanged power plan and drain active workloads.
Do not flash BIOS; it is unrelated and higher risk.
Do not infer physical segments from Redfish or SSH.
Stop on unexpected code, failed boot or lost management.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare code/timing reference and power/evidence plan.
Execute only an approved software-controlled power action if the later test plan explicitly authorizes it; this review executes nothing.
Collect/analyze supplied BMC/OS logs and images without claiming visual observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Confirm the code notation and exact power-state checkpoints.
Observe/capture the physical display during off/on transition.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incorrect and unsafe for this case: BIOS flashing and FirmwareInventory do not test a seven-segment POST display.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Remove the unrelated flash path from execution planning; retain controlled power plus physical visual observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 06, 02:, off/on sequence and 30/30-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use timestamped close-up video synchronized with BMC power-state and console timestamps, while a human identifies the segment pattern.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board after seven-segment map confirmation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, BMC and capture metadata.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds synchronized state evidence and explicitly rejects unrelated firmware flash.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; Redfish may corroborate power state but cannot replace the display.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The source's 02: notation must be clarified before verdict.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose an approved BMC or physical power-control method, but must preserve the two physical display observations and state exactly which on-state instant was assessed.
expected_evidence: Timestamped on-state 02: image and notation clarification

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria both concern the physical display. The unusual 02: token needs owner interpretation but does not contradict another primary source field; the DeepSeek mismatch is historical contamination, not a primary SOURCE_CONFLICT.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The display-check intent is clear; missing notation, observer or power inputs are readiness items.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejected because it belongs to the later same-code flash variant and lowers coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on MANUAL ONLY and visual/power safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly separates possible agent-controlled power support from the human visual core and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Eliminates an unrelated, destructive BIOS-flash substitution and binds evidence to the two required physical power/display states.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acceptance facts are emitted by a board-mounted seven-segment device. Even if power control and log collection are automated, the core physical observation remains human; therefore the case is MANUAL ONLY, not PARTIAL.

source_provenance.history: Repository exact-code search and distinct row 1461 BMC flash variant

no_automatic_retry: After an unexpected code or boot failure, preserve display/console evidence and stop; do not cycle power again automatically.
